statements: Four events P, Q, R, S are scheduled on four days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, one event per day.
Event P happens before event Q.
Event R happens the day after event Q.
Event S does not happen on Monday.
Event Q does not happen on Thursday.
Event S happens after event R.
Determine the day of each event.
